title: AlphaFold Database Search
description: Structural similarity search against the AlphaFold Human Proteome using Foldseek (3D structure) and/or MMseqs2 (sequence) with S3-hosted database.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

query_pdb.description: Query PDB structure file for Foldseek 3D search. Provide either this or query_fasta.

query_fasta.description: Query FASTA sequence file for MMseqs2 sequence search. Provide either this or query_pdb.

search_mode.description: Search algorithm. 'both' runs structure + sequence search and merges results; 'foldseek' requires PDB input; 'mmseqs2' requires FASTA input.

max_hits.description: Maximum number of hits to return from the database search.

evalue.description: E-value cutoff for MMseqs2 sequence search. Lower = more stringent.

min_seq_id.description: Minimum sequence identity for MMseqs2 hits. 0.0 = no filter (structure similarity may diverge at low identity).

coverage.description: Minimum alignment coverage fraction required. 0.8 = 80% of query must be aligned.

s3_db_base.description: S3 base path for the AlphaFold database. Pre-built with all 48k human proteome structures.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline.

outdir.description: The output directory where results will be saved.
